sentences.text: Yes—if the delay in releasing the original property documents is attributable to a UCB, the UCB shall compensate the borrower at the rate of ₹5,000 for each day of delay.
The documents also state that the UCB shall communicate reasons for delay in releasing original movable / immovable property documents beyond 30 days after full repayment / settlement of loan.
The bank’s own loan documents similarly say the original property documents shall be released within 30 days after full repayment / repayment of the Outstanding Balance in full.
